intro.en: Flexible leads must be specified against their installed motion, not selected by hand feel alone.
intro.zh: 柔性引线必须按安装后的运动工况选型，不能只凭手感。

knowledge.en: Fine stranding, core lay, jacket, support and termination jointly govern the moving assembly.
knowledge.zh: 细绞导体、芯线绞合、护套、支撑和端接共同决定活动组件的表现。

notes.en: Provide bend radius, cycle and torsion duty, connector drawings and environmental exposure.
notes.zh: 请提供弯曲半径、循环与扭转工况、接头图纸及环境条件。

delivery.en: Release the cable and its finished interfaces against project-specific first-article and acceptance checks.
delivery.zh: 按项目特定的首件与验收要求，放行线缆及完整接口。

lead.en: Softness is not a flex-life rating.
lead.zh: 柔软手感不是运动寿命额定值。
